sectionsUsed: Java SE 25 API, String class description: Strings are constant; their values cannot be changed after they are created.

Java SE 25 API, String methods length, charAt, substring(beginIndex, endIndex) (ends at endIndex - 1), indexOf (returns -1 if absent), toUpperCase, toLowerCase, strip, trim, isEmpty, equals and contains: return types and exceptions such as StringIndexOutOfBoundsException.
Dev.java, Strings: creating strings, concatenation with + (including numbers), zero-based character indexes and common String methods.
JEP 378, Text Blocks: the triple-quote text block syntax for multi-line string literals.
